info.title: Heir public API
info.summary: Read League players, ratings, competition and inventory, and check fixture eligibility.
info.description:
Read-only calls for game servers, overlays and other tools. League display reads need no key and work on every plan. Eligibility checks require a League developer key and its gamemode grant.

Without a key, each address may make 120 League and inventory reads a minute, across every League. To read more, send the League's developer key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` from your server: reads are then limited per key by the League's plan (Free 120, Pro 600, Ultimate 1,800, Enterprise 6,000 or as agreed), wherever the key is called from. A key reads only its own League. Never put a key in a game client or browser.

Inventory calls require Pro or above and an open shop. League display reads require an active League. Everything returned by keyless reads is already public on the League's pages.

- **Players are named by game account**, such as a PlayFab ID, never by Discord ID.
- **An empty list means there is nothing to show**: the player holds nothing, or has not linked that game account to Heir. The API does not say which.
- **An item belongs to the player.** A player who left the League, or was banned from it, is still answered with the items they hold.
- **Match on an item's `key`.** A key never changes once a member holds the item; names and images can.
- **Answers are cached for a minute**, so a purchase can take that long to appear.
- **Fields are only ever added** within `/public/v1`. Ignore fields you do not know.

get.description: Read paginated rated results and their MMR changes, newest first. This is rating history: results without an MMR event are not included. sourceKey identifies the rated source; matchId is null for sources without an official fixture result. Use nextToken from the previous response to continue with the same League and filters; null ends the list. pageSize may change between requests (1–100). Legacy page is zero-based and cannot be combined with nextToken. Paginated responses use Cache-Control: no-store. History, Rosters and fixtures use live cursors lasting 30 minutes; renamed or rescheduled entries can move. Leaderboards and standings use a five-minute snapshot; snapshotAt and snapshotExpiresAt describe it. A 410 means restart without the token. Ranking snapshots are limited to 100,000 rows or 16 MiB (422 if exceeded).

get.description: Read an official result or approved tracked/custom recording by UUID. Pending and rejected recordings are not public. Stat history follows the League's retention allowance. ratingStatus is rated when an MMR event exists, otherwise not-rated; not-rated does not imply a processing failure. Official results return the score; recordings return per-game player stats.

post.description: Check up to 100 game IDs against a fixture and one of its Rosters using that League's developer key and a granted gamemode. Returns current membership, linked-identity, Roster, ban and block verdicts with machine-readable reasons, never moderation notes. This advisory check does not reserve seats or approve substitute exceptions. Call from your server; never expose the key in a game client or browser. Responses are not cached; API errors are not eligibility verdicts.

get.description: Returns the items one game account's owner holds in the League right now. Use it when a player joins your server.

parameters.name: league
parameters.description: The League, as it appears in its Heir address: its vanity name (`heir.gg/nacl`) or its Discord server ID.

parameters.name: credential
parameters.description: Which kind of game account the identifier is. Use a key from the League's `items` call: `mordhau` for a Mordhau PlayFab ID, `steam` for a SteamID64.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: The player's game account ID, in the credential's format. Letter case does not matter for a PlayFab ID.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Only answer about this item key. The list then has one entry or none.

200.description: The player's held items. An empty list is a normal answer.

Cache-Control.description: Answers may be cached for 60 seconds.

ETag.description: Send it back as `If-None-Match` to get `304 Not Modified` when nothing changed.

304.description: Nothing changed since the `ETag` you sent.

400.description: The credential is not one this League's game uses, or the identifier is not in that credential's format.

example.message: A PlayFab ID is 14-16 characters using only 0-9 and A-F.

401.description: The Authorization header is not a valid League developer key. Send a valid key, or no Authorization header to read without one.

example.message: Send a valid League developer key as Authorization: Bearer <key>, or send no Authorization header.

403.description: The developer key belongs to another League. A key reads only its own League.

example.message: This key belongs to another League. Send it only to its own League, or send no key.

404.description: There is no public inventory at that address. The League does not exist, is not on a plan that includes the API, or has its shop turned off. All three look the same.

example.message: No League with a public inventory was found at that address.

429.description: Too many requests in the last minute: 120 from one address without a key, or the key's plan allowance with one. Wait and try again; cache answers for a minute instead of asking on every event.

example.message: Requests without a key are limited to 120 a minute from one address. Try again in a minute, or send a League developer key.
